Subject: POC kickoff: next steps & timeline (Acme)

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off: 

- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Acme's document summarization pipeline (throughput and cost targets)
- Success criteria: 95th p50 latency under 450ms for 1k/s simulated load, regression <5% vs baseline, and cost target <$0.015/token for steady-state.
- Deliverables: POC environment, sample dataset ingestion, 2-week run with monitoring dashboard, and a short wrap-up with findings.

Actions / asks from Acme:
1) Confirm kickoff window: tentatively the week of Nov 29 — which days/times work for your infra team?
2) Provide temporary service account and a key with read-only S3 access for the sample bucket (or let us walk through setup on the call).
3) Point us to any security questionnaire items we should pre-fill (we can do a pre-check).

Attached: POC-Plan-v1.pdf — includes scope, timeline, and minimal infra checklist.

If we don't hear back by end of week I can send a quick follow-up with a few concrete time slots. Happy to shorten the kickoff to a 30-min technical sync if that's easier for your infra/eng team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
